channel.title: Marko Lošić — Blog
channel.description: Notes on QA, test automation, mobile and AI testing.

item.title: Self-Healing Tests: What They Actually Fix, and What They Quietly Break
item.description: Self-healing test tools patch broken selectors automatically, but they can also hide the very defects your suite exists to catch. Here's how to use them safely.

item.title: Asserting Too Early: The Quiet Source of Flaky Playwright Tests
item.description: Many flaky Playwright tests aren't slow, they check too early. How instant checks and missing awaits cause false failures and false passes.

item.title: Why Maestro Deserves a Spot in Your Web Testing Toolkit
item.description: Maestro is known as a mobile UI testing tool, but its browser support quietly closes the gap with web testing. Here's why I reach for it, and how to write your first flow.
